title: Members
intro: The members of the circle and how they sign in (login names are not shown). When a member has lost every way to sign in and every recovery code, create a one-time reset link (valid for 24 hours) from their row and send it through a channel you trust. You confirm it is you first.
loadError: Could not load the members. Check your connection and try again.
pendingReset: A reset link is waiting, valid until {{date}}

reset.title: Reset links
reset.intro: Every reset link and its state; pending links can be revoked. Reset links are created from the member list above.
reset.shownOnce: This link is shown this once and works once. A new link for the same member makes this one invalid.
reset.loadError: Could not load the reset links. Check your connection and try again.

errors.notFound: This member has left or no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.self: You cannot create a reset link for yourself; manage your own ways to sign in on your page.

tree.title: Invite tree
tree.intro: Who invited whom (no login names, no pseudonyms). A branch is a member and everyone invited below them. Before stopping a branch's invites or removing it you see who it applies to; maintainers are listed but left alone. You confirm it is you first.
tree.loadError: Could not load the invite tree. Check your connection and try again.
tree.stopped_one: Stopped the invites of {{count}} member in the branch of {{name}}.
tree.stopped_other: Stopped the invites of {{count}} members in the branch of {{name}}.
tree.removed_one: Removed {{count}} member in the branch of {{name}}.
tree.removed_other: Removed {{count}} members in the branch of {{name}}.

preview.stopTitle: Stop the invites of the branch of {{name}}

invites.error: Could not change the invite permission. Reload and try again.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}
remove.explanation: A removed member is signed out at once and cannot sign in again; their unused invite links stop working.
remove.hideHint: Recommendations under the main name and the pseudonym are hidden from members; maintainers still see them, with the reason.
remove.keepHint: Main-name recommendations show as by a member who left; pseudonym ones keep the pseudonym.
remove.reasonHint: Goes into the audit log; when hiding, maintainers see it on the hidden recommendations.

errors.notFound: This member has left or does not exist. Reload the page.
errors.removeMaintainer: Maintainers cannot be removed. Revoke their maintainer role first.
errors.demoteSelf: You cannot revoke your own maintainer role.
errors.lastMaintainer: The circle needs at least one maintainer.
errors.branchChanged: The invite tree changed after the preview. Check the new list and confirm again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.
